protocol_amendment.reason: Independent V3 theory and red-team review found that duplicate draws omitted other applicable mathematical rejection reasons, closed key sets were not exact-type closed, ordering conventions were incompletely frozen, standalone gate helpers checked only part of the exhausted-cell vector, canonical mutation coverage was incomplete, and implementation failures were mixed into mathematical falsification.

Close exact JSON value types throughout V4 rows and documents and reject Boolean, integer, and float equality aliases even after every enclosing digest and byte receipt is refreshed.

Independently verify the exact ordered 168-row envelope, public and private cap associations, node caps, full curve transcripts within each bit-seed key, and accepted-curve uniqueness across keys.
Add committed mutations for missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, wrong-cap, wrong-node-cap, inconsistent-curve, and cross-seed-duplicate canonical matrices.
Add a third exhaustive full-objective oracle over every independent subset of the frozen p=19 B=4 graph and compare all four density caps without calling branch-and-bound or deterministic replay.

Restrict mathematical falsification to outcomes of a complete valid exact matrix; classify provenance, control, type, scalar-leakage, resource, and verifier failures as invalid evidence and INCONCLUSIVE.
Retain the V3 accounting boundary and authorize no new curve-family row, canonical run, runner, or launch plan.
